architecture.value: Transformer audio-chat model: Whisper large-v3 encoder, MLP adapter (4x downsample to 12.5 Hz), language decoder on Ministral 3B (Mini) or Mistral Small 3.1 24B (Small)

source.quote:
Voxtral is based on the Transformer architecture [Vaswani et al., 2017], consisting of three components:
an audio encoder to process speech inputs, an adapter layer to downsample audio embeddings, and a
language decoder to reason and generate text outputs.

findings.text: For Voxtral Small, Online Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) improved speech understanding (SU) quality scores but slightly hurt English short-form automatic speech recognition (ASR), so the default public checkpoint stays the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) model.

source.quote: Hence, the default checkpoint remains the SFT model.

notes: Technical report on Voxtral Mini and Small audio chat models. No safety, refusal, jailbreak, bias, toxicity, privacy, or dangerous-capability section or numeric safety evals. Capability-only results skipped per pilot: speech recognition WER (Figure 3, Tables 3–6), FLEURS translation BLEU (Figure 4, Table 7), speech understanding / Llama QA / Openbook QA / synthesized GSM8K TriviaQA MMLU (Figure 5, Table 8), internal SU LLM-judge scores (Table 2), text-only benchmarks (Figure 6), and architectural ablations (Figures 7–9). VoiceBench is cited as prior work only; no VoiceBench/AdvBench scores. Charts are mostly image bars; Table 2 is helpfulness/quality not safety. Hallucination topic covered only by an informal qualitative claim, not a measured eval.
